entities.name: PMID:10727759
observations: Prospective cohort: 224 patients with premature atherothrombotic cerebrovascular disease; follow-up available for 203 over median 57 months.
Among patients with events observed, incidence was 20.5% (31/151) in normohomocysteinaemia versus 21.2% (11/52) in vitamin B6 plus folic acid-treated hyperhomocysteinaemia.

Adjusted relative risk for treated hyperhomocysteinaemia versus normohomocysteinaemia was 0.96 (95% CI 0.48–1.92); observational findings are compatible with similar risk but do not prove equivalence or a treatment effect.
